Expected 16 collectives (8 RS + 8 AG); increases dispatch count but enables better memory locality and potential pipelining of scatter/gather phases across stages.

Apply bidiagonal coupling at node granularity first, then global. Expected ~16 collectives (8 stages × 2 levels); reduces cross-node bandwidth pressure by aggregating within nodes.

strategies.name: Fused Coupling with Buffered All-Reduce
strategies.desc: Pre-compute multiple stages of bidiagonal coupling locally before dispatching all_reduce, leveraging that coupling is deterministic on the summed structure. Batch 2-4 stages together to reduce collective count to 2-4 all_reduce calls. Trades increased local memory (multiple buffers) and compute (speculative coupling) for fewer network dispatches.
